questions.question: 1. What role does the GNSS base station play in surveying?

answers.b: Acts as a fixed reference for corrections

questions.question: 2. The GNSS rover is mainly used to?

answers.a: Stay fixed at a known location
answers.b: Collect position data at different field points

questions.question: 3. What is the main use of a drone in land surveying?

answers.a: Sending correction signals to the rover
answers.b: Capturing aerial photographs of the survey area

questions.question: 4. Why are GNSS rover measurements combined with drone images?

answers.b: To improve mapping accuracy using ground control points
answers.d: To avoid using a base station

questions.question: 5. Combining GNSS and drone technology in surveying provides?

answers.b: Efficient and highly accurate survey data
